notes: Introduced one global download queue across every search, so new searches never replace or bypass existing downloads.
Added multi-season searching, saved searches, smarter release rules, per-series preferences, and recommendation preselection.
Added size sanity checks, episode coverage warnings, duplicate detection, and local episode conflict checks before downloading.
Added system-tray support, optional Windows notifications, keyboard shortcuts, and release context menus.
Added bandwidth profiles and optional scheduled queue start times.
Expanded History with filters and storage statistics.
Added health checks, database backup/repair, and stale temp/log cleanup.
Added update rollback, Stable/Beta update channels, and richer changelog history.
Added manual naming overrides and clearer AI/alias naming transparency.
